name: japan-host
description: The /japan/ Worker (named ortho-japan on Cloudflare). It serves only: every app with package.json servedAt "/japan/" (japan-map = the front page, onsen, scene, …) is built and gathered into dist/site/japan by packages/globe/scripts/lib/gather-apps.mjs, and build:prod adds the SDK (sdk/japan) at /japan/lib/.

scripts.build:prod: npm run build -w @ortho-earth/japan && node ../../packages/globe/scripts/lib/gather-apps.mjs /japan/ --clean && cp -R ../../sdk/japan/dist/lib dist/site/japan/lib && find dist/site/japan/lib -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local && wrangler dev
